column1: #   soul        : canonical lowercase Soul key (e.g. shinobi, kagemusha, astromancer)
#   id          : vanilla FFXI resource ID (spell 0..1023, weaponskill 0..511, ability 512..2047)
#   icon_id     : optional classic icon ID (0..65534, or 65535 to keep vanilla)
#   icon_id_v2  : optional HD icon ID (0..65534, or 65535 to keep vanilla)
# Editing this file and running /soulactions reload updates native menus immediately without rebuilding crystaljobs.dll.

column5: Strike one enemy with light. Costs 8% max MP. 6s recast.
Burn one enemy with concentrated light. Costs 12% max MP. 8s recast.
Smite one enemy with a pillar of light. Costs 16% max MP. 12s recast.
Commit to a heavy light strike against one enemy. Costs 20% max MP, 22% at Lv.70 with increased power. 14s recast.
Empower your next damaging Zealot spell by 20%. Lasts up to 20s. 90s recast.
Strike one enemy with a lance of light. Costs 15 MP. 15s recast.
Designate yourself or one nearby party member for escort. 5s recast.
After enemy damage interrupts your Wingmate, protect one retry of the same spell within 6s. MP refund scales with level. 25s recast.
Fire probe. Damage aligns Ancient Invocation to this element. 6 MP. 3s recast.
Ice probe. Damage aligns Ancient Invocation to this element. 8 MP. 3s recast.
Wind probe. Damage aligns Ancient Invocation to this element. 6 MP. 3s recast.
Earth probe. Damage aligns Ancient Invocation to this element. 4 MP. 3s recast.
Thunder probe. Damage aligns Ancient Invocation to this element. 9 MP. 3s recast.
Water probe. Damage aligns Ancient Invocation to this element. 5 MP. 3s recast.
Invoke Ancient Magic in your last damaging probe element, or earth by default. Costs 16% max MP. 18s shared recovery.
Read the weakest elemental resistances of one enemy. Costs 2% max MP. 30s recast.
Return to your home point. Costs 100 MP. 10s recast.
Fire Ancient Magic against one enemy. Costs 22% max MP. 18s shared recovery. Can trigger Astral Saturation.
Ice Ancient Magic against one enemy. Costs 22% max MP. 18s shared recovery. Can trigger Astral Saturation.
Wind Ancient Magic against one enemy. Costs 22% max MP. 18s shared recovery. Can trigger Astral Saturation.
Earth Ancient Magic against one enemy. Costs 22% max MP. 18s shared recovery. Can trigger Astral Saturation.
Thunder Ancient Magic against one enemy. Costs 22% max MP. 18s shared recovery. Can trigger Astral Saturation.
Water Ancient Magic against one enemy. Costs 22% max MP. 18s shared recovery. Can trigger Astral Saturation.
Recover 10% of your maximum MP. 90s recast.
Discharge a low-cost single-target arc. Costs 9 MP. 4s recast.
Siphon MP from one enemy that has MP. Costs 10 MP. 60s recast.
Channel for up to 8s to speed and discount one eligible party spell. Self-link discounts MP only. 24s recast.
Single-target flame stitch. Yin increases its damage. 3s recast.
Single-target frost stitch. Yin increases its damage. 3s recast.
Single-target wind stitch. Yin increases its damage. 3s recast.
Single-target earth stitch. Yin increases its damage. 3s recast.
Single-target lightning stitch. Yin increases its damage. 3s recast.
Single-target tidal stitch. Yin increases its damage. 3s recast.
Stronger single-target flame weave. Yin increases its damage. 6s recast.
Stronger single-target lightning weave. Yin increases its damage. 7s recast.
Commit to a strong single-target wind weave. Yin increases its damage. 12s recast.
Enter Yin to strengthen your Scarlet Weaver spells. In combat, both forms share a 12s recast and a 2s recovery.
Enter Yang to strengthen regular main-hand sword hits. In combat, both forms share a 12s recast and a 2s recovery.
Hinder one enemy attack speed. Landing this opens Advance. 20s recast.
Interfere with one enemy action. Landing this opens Advance. 10s recast.
Reduce one enemy accuracy. Landing this opens Recompose. 10s recast.
Stop one enemy from casting magic. Landing this opens Recompose. 10s recast.
Remove one enemy enhancement and reopen the last order you issued. 10s recast.
Issue the order opened by your latest successful enfeeble. Costs no MP. Targets one party member or yourself. 18s recast.
Prepare a critical strike from behind. Lasts up to 20s. 45s recast.
Read one enemy for a personal opening that qualifies your next landed weapon skill for Opportunism. Lasts 15s. 24s recast.
Route your next qualifying hit or weapon skill threat to the party member between you and your enemy. Lasts up to 20s. 35s recast.
Challenge one enemy for threat and guard one magical or breath hit within 6s. 15y range. 18s recast.
Strike one enemy with light from range. Costs 15 MP. 15s recast.
Commit before combat to stronger Great Sword swings and 10% more damage taken from enemies. Vows share a 5s recast.
Commit before combat to retaliation. Losing at least 8% max HP to one enemy hit opens an empowered Reckoning. Vows share a 5s recast.
Strike with your Great Sword. An armed retaliation doubles damage against the enemy that hit you. 18s recast.
Summon 2 offensive shadow clones against your engaged enemy (max 5 active, 25-30s, zero defensive shadows). 20s recast.
Summon 3 offensive shadow clones against your engaged enemy (max 5 active, 25-30s, zero defensive shadows). 30s recast.
Squad feint strike that creates a 12s Opening (+25% potency or +2s duration on your next different squad command). Advances tactical phase. 12s recast.
Shifts living shadows into an alternating fast/heavy attack rhythm for 10s, scaling with squad size (2-5 clones). Advances tactical phase. 16s recast.
Orders surviving shadows to execute rapid staggered single-target physical strikes against your engaged enemy. Advances or triggers Cascade. 14s recast.
Locks living shadows onto your engaged enemy for 12s (+ACC/+melee, refreshes focus, extends active phase +4s). No enemy debuff. 18s recast.
High-tempo escalating sequential strikes across living shadows (requires 2+ clones for full relay chain). Advances or triggers Cascade. 22s recast.
High-commitment single-target finisher scaling with living clones (1-5) and consuming your active tactical phase for peak burst. 45s recast.
Every living shadow launches one staggered single-target physical strike at your engaged enemy. Integrates with Opening and tactical phases. 90s recast.
Reduces living shadows' native autoattack interval by 25% for 8s while preserving staggered attack timing. Integrates with tactical phases. 30s recast.
Strike with your Scythe. Land during enemy recovery for greater damage, with a finishing bonus from Lv.50. 16s recast.
Strike one enemy with darkness from range. Enemy recovery increases the damage. Costs 12 MP. 12s recast.
Curse one enemy to dampen its physical TP moves for 24 seconds. Shares a 12s recast with other curses.
Curse one enemy to dampen its damaging spells for 24 seconds. Shares a 12s recast with other curses.
Curse one enemy to reduce its own combat healing for 24 seconds. Shares a 12s recast with other curses.
Recover MP while your current enemy bears one of your curses or immunity wards. 24s recast.
Aim for 3 seconds, then fire one powerful gun or crossbow shot within 20 yalms. Movement can cancel aim. 12s recast.
Toggle a 4-second aim for greater Sightline Shot damage. 5s recast.
Fire one attuned arrow to mark an enemy within 20 yalms. The next matching party spell or skillchain deals more damage. 16s recast.
Select the next element for Attunement Arrow. 1s recast.
Select the previous element for Attunement Arrow. 1s recast.
Seal a hostile spell within 15 yalms. An interruptible spell can be stopped. If it completes, its direct damage is reduced. Shared cooldown: 20 seconds, 18 from Lv.50.
Seal a readied enemy technique within 15 yalms. Physical damage from that move is reduced. Shared cooldown: 20 seconds, 18 from Lv.50.
Strike one enemy with fire. Uses no ninja tools. 10s recast.
Prepare for 8 seconds. Your next valid seal cast takes 0.25 seconds. 45s recast.
Leap and strike with your polearm. From Lv.50, a landed long vault can strengthen this hit against the same enemy. 60s recast.
Vault to an enemy 4 to 12 yalms away and strike with your polearm. A longer lane hits harder. Blocked terrain gives a three-second retry. 18s recast.
